title: Enzyme Evidence Atlas
description: A living literature map for enzyme discovery, engineering and design.

objectives.Discovery: Identifying previously unknown enzyme–function relationships in natural or non-natural sequence space.
objectives.Engineering: Modifying an existing enzyme or scaffold to change its measured properties.
objectives.Design: Specifying or constructing sequences, structures or active sites intended to deliver a desired function.

note: Objective labels are non-exclusive, operational research objectives, not a universal ontology. Method and evidence labels are separate. Counts describe this indexed collection, never field-wide prevalence.
